description: pkix-path-builder/src/lib.rs:948-955 — the comparison table in build_first_valid_path's rustdoc lists 3 entry points: build_path / build_path_candidates / build_first_valid_path. It does NOT list the corresponding _with_config variants. Every API in the crate has paired default + config entry points; the table presents only half. Reader hitting that table from rustdoc has to scroll back to discover the with_config siblings exist. Either add three more rows or add a footnote like "each entry point has a _with_config sibling accepting a PathBuilderConfig". One-line fix.
title: build_first_valid_path doc table at lib.rs:948-955 omits PathBuilderConfig variant; inconsistent with other rustdocs
